Part 1 Assessment: Brightwater Swim School

The timed assessment that closes Part 1 (Sessions 1 to 8), run in Session 8 from 1:25 (setup) to 2:35. Each learner works alone for 60 minutes, open book, on a classic theme they have never seen: brightwater, half finished by a developer who left. The starter activates and runs without a message; learners add the theme setup, the stylesheet and the Loop, change the main query, and find three bugs from the client's reports. It tests Module 4 (the Loop, template tags, custom queries, functions.php) with escaping and hooks from Modules 1 and 2; the block-theme side (Module 3) is the project's. Score it with the five-row rubric below. This section is for instructors only.

The site works, sort of: our menu never shows, the news page lists bare titles, there is no stylesheet, the search page did something strange when my nephew typed HTML into it, and the previous and next links under a post point to the wrong posts. Can you finish it this afternoon?”

Part 1 Assessment: Scoring Guidance by Row

  • Run first, then read: unzip into a course site at the end of Lesson 4.3 as wp-content/themes/brightwater/, activate, run test_brightwater.php, compare with the learner's selfcheck.txt, then read every changed file against the starter (diff -r brightwater_starter brightwater-<name>). Fifteen minutes per learner.
  • Theme setup and hooks. title-tag AND the hand-written <title> removed (the self-check reports the count); wp_body_open() where the starter's TODO stands; the location registered on after_setup_theme AND the header's two main references changed (fixing only one side leaves the menu hidden). The enqueue on wp_enqueue_scripts with the version from the theme header (wp_get_theme( get_template() )->get( 'Version' ) or wp_get_theme()->get( 'Version' )).
  • The Loop. Linked titles may use the_permalink() or echo esc_url( get_permalink() ); get_permalink() without echo prints nothing (a trap below). the_posts_pagination() after the loop, not inside it.
  • Main and secondary queries. pre_get_posts in functions.php with the three guards (as in the project). posts_per_page in a new WP_Query inside index.php is a 1 for this row (the main query still runs, and page 2 breaks). For T5, wp_reset_postdata() after the related loop (inside the if, after the while); wp_reset_query() works but is the wrong tool (it is for query_posts()): a 3 only with a correct explanation.
  • Escaping. esc_html( get_search_query( false ) ) or get_search_query() (escaped by default, a trap below shows it passes); printf( esc_html__( ... ), ... ) keeps the string translatable. Check every NEW echo the learner wrote (the date, attributes).
  • Working method. The self-check output handed in, no messages, prefixes and the text domain kept, an honest note when unfinished. A learner who explains a bug correctly in the note but ran out of time to fix it can still reach 3 on that row's understanding, never 4.

The three bugs and their fixes
  1. T1, "our menu never shows": header.php asks has_nav_menu( 'main' ) and wp_nav_menu( array( 'theme_location' => 'main', ... ) ); the theme must register primary and the header must ask for primary. Silent: no message, no menu.
  2. T4, the search heading: the starter prints get_search_query( false ) raw inside printf(). Fixed, /?s=<b>water</b> prints <h1 class="search-title">Results for: &lt;b&gt;water&lt;/b&gt;</h1>.
  3. T5, the wrong neighbors: related-news.php runs a secondary WP_Query and never calls wp_reset_postdata(), so the_post_navigation() in singular.php works from the last related post (Welcome, the oldest News post: no previous, next Staff picks). Fixed, Dune's own neighbors come back: Staff picks for the season Hello world!
The model solution's functions.php
<?php
/**
 * Brightwater functions and definitions.
 *
 * @package brightwater
 */

/**
 * Sets up the theme features WordPress should provide, and the menu location.
 */
function brightwater_setup() {
	add_theme_support( 'title-tag' );
	add_theme_support( 'html5', array( 'search-form', 'comment-form', 'comment-list', 'gallery', 'caption' ) );

	register_nav_menus(
		array(
			'primary' => __( 'Primary menu', 'brightwater' ),
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'after_setup_theme', 'brightwater_setup' );

/**
 * Loads the theme's stylesheet, versioned with the theme.
 */
function brightwater_enqueue_assets() {
	wp_enqueue_style(
		'brightwater-style',
		get_stylesheet_uri(),
		array(),
		wp_get_theme( get_template() )->get( 'Version' )
	);
}
add_action( 'wp_enqueue_scripts', 'brightwater_enqueue_assets' );

/**
 * Shows two posts per page on the blog home.
 *
 * @param WP_Query $query The query WordPress is about to run.
 */
function brightwater_adjust_main_query( $query ) {
	if ( is_admin() || ! $query->is_main_query() ) {
		return;
	}

	if ( $query->is_home() ) {
		$query->set( 'posts_per_page', 2 );
	}
}
add_action( 'pre_get_posts', 'brightwater_adjust_main_query' );

/**
 * Registers the footer widget area (stretch task).
 */
function brightwater_widgets_init() {
	register_sidebar(
		array(
			'id'            => 'footer',
			'name'          => __( 'Footer', 'brightwater' ),
			'before_widget' => '<section id="%1$s" class="widget %2$s">',
			'after_widget'  => '</section>',
			'before_title'  => '<h2 class="widget-title">',
			'after_title'   => '</h2>',
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'widgets_init', 'brightwater_widgets_init' );

Part 1 Assessment: Accommodations, Late Work and Completion

  • Accommodations: agreed extra time up to 30 more minutes in the room, or the same folder at home within 48 hours; a learner whose site breaks during the hour gets the repair time back.
  • Missed session: the take-home version (48 hours, open book, the same rules); note it on the scoring sheet.
  • Below Met: one resit within a week, at home, on the same folder with the feedback in hand, or a fresh run of the classroom version if you have another client's variant.
  • Part 1 completion: the project AND the assessment both Met. When Part 1 runs on its own, issue the certificate of completion after the project feedback; when Part 2 follows, a learner below Met on either may continue and revise in parallel.
